panels.title: Gear (now)
panels.description: DERIVED from the rpm/speed ratio (not sent by the bike). N = stopped, crawling, or clutch-in (no reliable ratio). Ladder documented in infra/vps/grafana/README.md.

targets.query:
// Gear is DERIVED, not a bike signal: gear = rpm/speed ratio -> nearest gear centroid.
// Thresholds are the geometric means of adjacent centroids (band boundaries).
// N (0) = stopped / crawling / clutch-in. See infra/vps/grafana/README.md.
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and (r._field == "rpm" or r._field == "speed"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value:
      if r.speed < 8.0 or r.rpm < 800.0 then 0.0
      else if r.rpm / r.speed >= 225.6 then 1.0
      else if r.rpm / r.speed >= 156.0 then 2.0
      else if r.rpm / r.speed >= 121.5 then 3.0
      else if r.rpm / r.speed >= 101.6 then 4.0
      else if r.rpm / r.speed >= 87.3 then 5.0
      else 6.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")

panels.title: GPS speed (now)
panels.description: True ground speed from the NEO-7M (Doppler). Independent of the OBD wheel-speed; blank until a GPS fix.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "gps_speed")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "rpm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "speed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)

panels.title: Gear ratio (rpm / speed) — dashed lines = gear centroids
panels.description: The raw signal gear is derived from (one point per sample, no averaging). Each dashed line is a gear centroid; the band a point sits in is its gear. Vertical smears between bands are shift transients. Read together with the gear guess panel beside it. See infra/vps/grafana/README.md.

panels.title: Gear guess
panels.description: Gear DERIVED per sample from the rpm/speed ratio, plotted on the Y axis (0 = N: stopped/crawling/clutch-in; 1-6 = gears). Colour = gear. Read against the ratio panel beside it. See infra/vps/grafana/README.md.

panels.title: GPS track
panels.description: Ride path from the NEO-7M (lat/lon). Small dots = the trail over the time range; the large red dot is the current position. Blank until a GPS fix.

targets.query:
// Current position: the most recent fix only (the large red dot).
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "lat", "lon"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> tail(n: 1)
